title: Sales By Customer's Sales Type menu has Select all and Clear selection
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Customer in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, with the date range set to today.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the Sales Type filter on first load.
  2. Click "Clear selection".
  3. Click "Select all".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Part Sales" and "Service Sales" each have a checkbox.
  • Both are ticked.
  • A "Select all" row is above them.
  • "Clear selection" is at the bottom.

Step 2:

  • Both options are cleared.
  • The filter reads "Sales Type: No sales".

Step 3:

  • Both options are ticked again.
  • The filter reads "Sales Type: All Sales".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • S8-R7: “Its two options read "Part Sales" and "Service Sales".”
  • S8-R8: “With both options selected, the filter reads "Sales Type: All Sales". With one, it reads that option's name, for example "Sales Type: Part Sales". With none, it reads "Sales Type: No sales".”

From: "SBC (Sales By Customer) Report" spec, Confluence 577634305, version 21 (6 Oct 2026), read 19 Oct 2026

  • Sales By Customer spec, S3-R2: “Its menu offers two options, each with a checkbox, "Part Sales" and "Service Sales", under a "Select all" row, with "Clear selection" at the bottom.”
  • Sales By Customer spec, S3-R3: “Both options are selected on first load.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
